<!--
Fill in as much as you know. It's OK to leave sections blank — the agent will ask
follow-up questions for anything missing or ambiguous before producing the analysis.
Do NOT guess numbers; leave them blank if unknown.
-->

## Business Context
<!-- Who is the company/team? What problem are they trying to solve? -->

## Business Objectives
<!-- What value must this system deliver? (2-3 objectives) -->

## What the System Must Do (Functional Requirements)
<!-- Bullet list -->

## Operating Conditions / Known Numbers
<!-- Throughput, latency, availability targets, data volume, growth projections, deadlines, etc. -->

## Constraints
<!-- Budget, timeline, team skills, compliance/regulatory, existing tech stack -->

## Security / Compliance Notes
<!-- PII, access control, audit requirements, industry regulations -->

## Anything Else Known
<!-- Team experience, existing systems to integrate with, prior attempts, etc. -->

---

**Requested output:** Full reasoning chain (objectives → constraints → requirements →
quality-attribute scenarios → ASRs → utility tree → decisions & trade-offs → tools →
open questions), delivered as an HTML report under `docs/`.
